notes.title: New Game Setup Enhancements
notes.content:

notes.title: Portraits & Trait Updates
notes.content:
As part of improving captain customization, we have added portraits. Furthermore, this will mean that crew be more than a name. 
Thank you for all of the feedback, testing, and bug reports. 

[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Portraits have been added:
    - Currently, only new games can have them
    - Looking to add a system to identify saves without portrait data and allow for one to be set
[*] New Game Panel have been updated to include the portrait creation
[*] Trait system overhauled
[*] Add Effects System:
    - The way effects from Traits and Items are now routed through this new system to keep them active when added
    - Previous save files will be able to utilize this system
    - Will be expanding this to allow for text summaries to be provided from here
[*] Localization updated for new features and working on the names list
[*] Added another Time Stamp Format. If there are more suggestions, please send them to us.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto Repair Bot - Price 7500 -> 8500 credits
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue that prevented Trade Computer bonuses from being calculated
[*] Addressed an issue where Merchant Level was not effecting the resale of mounts
[/list]

[h3]Future Work[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial text polishing and visuals
[*] Game Intro
[*] Job board overhaul to combine the tasks and crew options
[*] Crew role controls. Currently, the highest trait value takes the role
[*] More help on using the Market Compare mode (delta information)
[*] Flight route improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Spacefarers![/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that Epic Space Trader is now live on Steam! Embark on an interstellar journey where you command your starship, trade goods across the galaxy, and navigate cosmic threats to build your trading empire.

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Open-Ended Sandbox Experience:[/b] Choose your own path to riches, whether through trading, bounty hunting, or piracy.
[*] [b]Dynamic Markets:[/b] Exploit fluctuating prices to maximize your profits.
[*] [b]Space Hazards:[/b] Navigate asteroid fields, dodge pirates, and encounter unexpected challenges.
[*] [b]Procedurally Generated Galaxy:[/b] No two playthroughs are the same, with more than 8,000 galaxies to view, offering endless replayability.
[/list]
Join us in shaping the future of Epic Space Trader during our Early Access phase. Your feedback is invaluable in refining the game and ensuring it delivers an experience that transcends the celestial limits.

Chart your course, forge alliances, and carve your legend among the stars. Are you ready to trade your way to the top?

[b][h3]🌠 Download Epic Space Trader on today! 🌠[/h3][/b]
